overview: Dollard-des-Ormeaux had 48,403 residents in the 2021 Census, down 1.0 percent from 48,899 in 2016. Its 17,383 occupied dwellings fill just 14.98 square kilometres, making it a dense, fully built West Island suburb of single-family streets and apartment blocks.

The city is officially bilingual, and a large share of residents were born outside Canada. Shopping centres along boulevard des Sources and Highway 40 anchor local retail. For a local business, that means a stable, diverse customer base that must be won from competitors, often in English as well as French.
